apps.name: WorkHub
apps.subtitle: Inspections and ECC Daily Hand In
apps.localizedDescription: Native, local-first iPhone inspections and ECC Daily Hand In. Direct Google Drive access, PDF preview, native PDF merging, and ZIP exports. Distributed as an unsigned IPA for sideloading.
apps.versionDescription:
Improved: PDF Multi Tool now prepares preview source PDF documents off the main UI thread, preventing synchronous PDF document parsing in PDFView.makeUIView during sheet presentation.
Improved: PDFKit previews explicitly clear their PDF document reference on sheet teardown, and the SwiftUI preview releases its document after dismissal to reduce retained pages and renderer memory across multiple previews.
Improved: The thumbnail renderer retains at most one open source PDF document rather than one per imported file, while continuing to use its existing bounded low-resolution image cache. Source documents are released when leaving the PDF workspace or closing a preview.
Added: A PDF preview-loaded event and preview-dismissed event to opt-in UI responsiveness reports for more precise before/after PDFKit and memory measurements.
Added: A CI regression test verifying the preview load/teardown lifecycle and bounded thumbnail document retention.
Unchanged: Original PDFs, page order and rotations, export quality, selection, Google Drive inspection caches, Daily JHA and app appearance. Existing thumbnail images remain cached.

versions.localizedDescription:
Improved: PDF Multi Tool now prepares preview source PDF documents off the main UI thread, preventing synchronous PDF document parsing in PDFView.makeUIView during sheet presentation.
Improved: PDFKit previews explicitly clear their PDF document reference on sheet teardown, and the SwiftUI preview releases its document after dismissal to reduce retained pages and renderer memory across multiple previews.
Improved: The thumbnail renderer retains at most one open source PDF document rather than one per imported file, while continuing to use its existing bounded low-resolution image cache. Source documents are released when leaving the PDF workspace or closing a preview.
Added: A PDF preview-loaded event and preview-dismissed event to opt-in UI responsiveness reports for more precise before/after PDFKit and memory measurements.
Added: A CI regression test verifying the preview load/teardown lifecycle and bounded thumbnail document retention.
Unchanged: Original PDFs, page order and rotations, export quality, selection, Google Drive inspection caches, Daily JHA and app appearance. Existing thumbnail images remain cached.

Added: Performance Testing → Live Diagnostics now attributes display-link stalls and sampled memory changes to the active WorkHub tab or Field section, rather than showing only aggregate worst-gap and peak-memory numbers.
Added: A bounded timeline of tab changes and PDF workspace actions (import, preview, export and clear), with the twelve largest callback gaps and up to twenty-four recent actions in each shareable report. Only screen categories, counts, timestamps and memory are recorded—never inspection names or PDF filenames.
Added: Per-screen counts of slow callbacks, approximate missed callbacks, worst gap and sampled resident memory entry/peak/last, so Navigation and PDF-specific spikes can be compared directly.
Improved: Previous v0.7.3 diagnostic history remains readable; attribution is opt-in and runs only during the existing 20-second UI monitor. Correlation with a screen/action is not a proof of root cause.
Added: Regression tests verifying per-screen attribution and sampled memory accounting.
Unchanged: Existing PDF and thumbnail cache behavior, inspection caching, Daily JHA, performance microbenchmarks, icons and automatic IPA feed publishing.

Added: Settings → Performance Testing → Startup, UI smoothness & real PDFs, a new live diagnostic suite complementing repeatable benchmarks.
Added: An optional 20-second CADisplayLink measurement of main-run-loop callback intervals, 95th-percentile and worst callback gap, intervals over a 60 Hz target, approximate missed callbacks and sampled peak resident memory while navigating across WorkHub.
Added: Startup diagnostics for WorkHub initialization to first root view appearance, Google authentication restore duration and existing inspection metadata catalog disk loading. These are labeled as approximations, not full operating-system cold-launch instrumentation.
Added: Choose a PDF from Files to measure actual read-only copy, PDFKit open, bounded thumbnail rendering, and temporary three-page subset export. Supports PDFs up to 120 MB and 200 pages; never changes or retains the original document or filename.
Added: On-device diagnostic history with shareable aggregate text reports and cancellation; detailed results distinguish callback timing from GPU FPS and sampled memory from actual absolute peaks.
Added: Regression tests for frame timing and callback gap calculations.
Unchanged: Inspection search, Daily JHA, caches, PDF Multi Tool, Home Screen icon choices and automatic workhub-ios-feed IPA distribution.

Improved: WorkHub's indexed inspection search now performs fuzzy word matching only once per unique normalized term in the catalog, instead of repeating the same edit-distance checks across thousands of PDF names and shared date aliases.
Improved: Retains phrase matching, partial words, typo tolerance, filename-priority sorting, date aliases, and original result counts. One-time search index construction now deduplicates vocabulary words; interactive queries reuse those matches.
Added: Extended exact-result compatibility tests against the original search logic across 40 queries, including punctuation, accents, misspellings and date formats.
Improved: Benchmark reports identify the number of unique vocabulary words for indexed search to make device performance measurements easier to interpret.
Unchanged: Inspection metadata, cached PDFs, Google Drive updates, Daily JHA, PDF Multi Tool, app icons, and the feed distribution workflow.

Improved: Inspection Browse fuzzy search now reuses prepared normalized filenames and date aliases across keystrokes instead of repeatedly parsing and formatting every inspection date for every search.
Improved: The index is prepared off the main UI thread and refreshed when local inspection metadata changes, preserving fuzzy matching, search totals, filename-first ranking and result limits.
Added: Performance Testing separates one-time search preparation from warmed indexed search to make before/after performance comparisons meaningful.
Added: Automated regression checks compare all search result counts and ordering against the previous implementation across 24 queries, including date variants, typos and accented filenames.
Unchanged: Inspection metadata and PDF storage, Daily JHA, PDF Multi Tool, Home Screen icon options and the sideloader feed workflow.

Added: Settings → Testing & diagnostics → Performance Testing, a fully on-device benchmark lab for measuring app performance without altering inspections or documents.
Added: Repeatable synthetic inspection-index benchmarks for daily summaries, fuzzy search, cached metadata encode/decode and count lookups, plus 12-page PDFKit opening, thumbnail rendering, merge/export and temporary storage I/O.
Added: Optional read-only benchmarks of the device's existing cached inspection metadata. No Google Drive API requests, downloads, or modifications are made.
Added: App memory snapshots, thermal/Low Power Mode indicators, median/min/max timings, fast (3 samples) and detailed (5 samples) runs, cancellation, locally saved history and shareable text reports.
Improved: Previous-run comparisons support checking regressions after IPA updates. Test workloads use isolated synthetic data and temporary files, and production caches are left untouched.
Unchanged: All inspection workflows, Daily JHA, PDF Multi Tool, icon customization and automatic AltStore/SideStore publishing.

Fixed: WorkHub no longer falsely reports that changing the app icon failed when the iPhone Home Screen changes but UIApplication.alternateIconName remains stale.
Fixed: Selection now persists after the UIKit completion handler reports success, including when restoring the original icon, so the correct gallery checkmark survives relaunch.
Improved: A valid stored successful selection takes precedence over a stale iOS icon-name getter; first-launch fallback still uses the actual getter when there is no saved choice.
Added: Regression tests for stale nil/old system values, successful changes, restoring Original WorkHub, and genuine iOS errors.
Unchanged: All 12 alternate icon designs, original AppIcon, inspection workflows, Daily JHA, PDF tools, and automatic sideloader feed publishing.

Updated: Redesigned all twelve alternate WorkHub iPhone app icons with genuinely distinct central silhouettes at Home Screen size, rather than near-identical logo recolors.
Updated: Each option has a construction or inspection identity (hardhat, blueprint, shield, lift, harness, WH monogram, checklist, tools, documents, gear, fieldwork) and consistent WorkHub blue, white and orange palette.
Improved: Smaller-size visual differentiation tests ensure all twelve choices remain distinct even in a 60px Home Screen preview.
Unchanged: The original primary WorkHub icon, icon identifiers and restore-original action remain intact. Inspections, Daily JHA, PDF Multi Tool and cached data are unchanged.

Updated: Twelve Home Screen icon alternatives now retain the original WorkHub hardhat, checklist and orange arc, with distinct engineering, construction and framing details.
Fixed: The new Original WorkHub action explicitly restores the default app icon via the iOS nil icon name.
Fixed: Icon-selection feedback checks the actual UIKit icon (including after foregrounding), waits for the operating system to apply the change and reports real failures instead of treating a tapped preview as applied.
Improved: Alternative icon system identifiers are unchanged, preserving selections across upgrades.
Unchanged: Inspection dashboard icons, Google Drive, Daily JHA, inspection caches and PDF Multi Tool.

Added: Choose WorkHub's actual iPhone Home Screen app icon from 13 visual options under Settings → Customize WorkHub → Home Screen app icon.
Added: Twelve original 1024px alternate icons with different artwork: Blueprint, Hardhat, Night Shift, Safety Shield, Scissor Lift, Fall Protection, WH Monogram, Inspection, Toolbox, Documents, Industrial, and Fieldwork, plus the original Classic.
Added: Large live icon previews, selected-state badges, and system-level icon changing through iOS's supported setAlternateIconName API.
Improved: Clear feedback if a sideloading/signing method disables alternate icons or the icon change fails; WorkHub never falsely reports a change.
Verified: GitHub Actions checks every generated image and all alternate registrations in the production IPA's Info.plist.
Unchanged: Inspection dashboard icon customization, Google Drive, Daily Hand In, offline cache, and PDF Multi Tool.

Fixed: Missing Lift pictograms on the Today dashboard and source rows; removed the unsupported SF Symbol that rendered blank.
Updated: Harness now defaults to a custom safety-harness drawing, while Lift defaults to a recognizable scissor-lift drawing instead of a generic checklist/unsupported symbol.
Added: Appearance → Inspections layout → Today dashboard icon designs, with 10 genuinely different pictograms for Harness and 10 for Lift, each independently selectable with a live visual preview.
Improved: Native SwiftUI vector equipment artwork remains sharp in any appearance mode; unsupported optional system symbols gracefully fall back to an equipment icon instead of disappearing.
Improved: Removed misleading action arrows from noninteractive Today summary cards.
Unchanged: Inspection counts, Today refresh, ECC Daily Hand In, offline cache and PDF Multi Tool behavior remain the same.

Fixed: Daily Hand In always checks current-day ECC Harness and Lift inspection folders live before generating PDFs, even when the local 24-hour cache previously showed no submissions.
Updated: The same lightweight live check refreshes today's PDF metadata and folder counts across ECC and CAMH, and saves the changes for Browse and the Today dashboard.
Improved: Subsequent inspection-cache updates fetch only today's mutable date plus any days that need one final post-midnight check; historical completed days are never scanned again.
Improved: Existing on-device inspection catalogs migrate automatically to the finalized-day watermark without deleting saved PDFs or triggering a complete historical rescan.
Updated: Inspection cache settings explain incremental refresh and permanent past-day retention.
Unchanged: Downloaded ECC inspection PDFs remain stored on-device, and Daily Hand In's ZIP/clipboard workflow, PDF Multi Tool and appearance settings remain intact.

Added: Rotate individual uploaded PDF or image pages 90° left or right in PDF Multi Tool, including Rotate controls in page menus and the full-page preview.
Updated: PDF thumbnails, preview and final merged export reflect each page's independent rotation; source PDFs stay unchanged.
Added: Left/right rotation controls for individual Daily JHA photos, including camera and Photos library imports.
Updated: Daily JHA export supports mixed portrait and landscape PDF page sizes rather than forcing every photo onto a portrait sheet.
Added: Automated rotation regression tests and output orientation checks.
Unchanged: Inspections, Today dashboard, Google Drive and sideloader workflows remain intact.

Fixed: The Browse search field now sits beneath the Browse / Today / Daily JHA switch, preventing the switch from jumping downward when opening Browse.
Improved: A compact inline search box provides a clear button and keeps the navigation bar at a constant height.
Unchanged: Fuzzy name/date search remains available in Browse only. Today dashboard, Daily JHA drafts, inspection caches and appearance settings are preserved.

Added: A new Today tab inside Inspections with a dashboard of PDFs filed in today's dated Google Drive inspection folders.
Added: Live total, Harness/Lift and ECC/CAMH breakdown cards, per-source counts, and preview/share access to today's PDFs.
Improved: A dedicated lightweight lookup checks only today's folders, caches its results for five minutes, and preserves previously saved data if Google Drive is temporarily unavailable.
Added: Appearance options to hide the Today tab or open the field-work screen directly to Today.
Unchanged: Bulk inspections use their 24-hour cache; Daily Hand In, PDF Multi Tool, and existing appearance settings are preserved.

Fixed: Inspections by day no longer groups and sorts all date folders every time the screen redraws; daily totals and display dates are precomputed once and saved with the 24-hour local index.
Improved: Folder PDF count badges now use constant-time lookups instead of scanning every date folder.
Improved: The daily breakdown shows seven days initially, with older dates added in small batches to keep navigation responsive.
Added: An automated large-catalog regression test covering 1,344 folders, 6,720 PDFs, cross-source daily counts, and migration of existing cached indexes.
Unchanged: Inspections by day remains optional in Appearance. Google Drive, Daily Hand In, offline caching, and PDF Multi Tool are preserved.

Updated: Complete inspection metadata and folder listings persist locally; automatic refresh checks run every 24 hours while WorkHub is active or when reopened.
Added: Optional full offline PDF downloads with progress, resume and storage safeguards.
Fixed: Bulk inspection search appears only in Browse, never on Daily Hand In.
Added: Appearance controls for search, dashboards, per-folder counters and cache maintenance.
Fixed: Sideloader version history now uses accurate, distinct Added/Updated/Fixed/Removed notes for every prior release.

Added: Local fuzzy inspection search by PDF name, partial words and multiple date formats.
Added: PDF counters per date folder, per source and across the full inspection directory.
Added: Daily totals combined across ECC/CAMH sources.
Updated: Metadata indexing uses batched Drive requests with progress and caching.

Added: Appearance Studio with 12 preset accent colors, custom HEX and theme controls.
Added: Reorderable bottom tabs, startup-tab choices and screen-density options.
Added: PDF grid/list, filename visibility and Daily Hand In layout customization.
Added: Focused, Balanced and Detailed appearance presets.

Fixed: Files document imports using a reliable copy-mode iOS document picker.
Updated: PDF reordering uses native drag handles in a dedicated Pages/Whole Files list.
Merged: Inspections and Daily Hand In into one field-work tab.
Added: Appearance settings for themes, accents, module visibility and page density.
Removed: Redundant Google Drive banners and source-folder clutter from the default screens.

Added: Dedicated PDF Arrange mode with numbered thumbnails and improved page movement.
Added: Whole-file reordering, Undo and precise page-move controls.
Updated: PDF workspace layout emphasizes page order during rearrangement.

Added: Small, Balanced and High image-compression presets for new PDF workspace images.
Updated: Images are downsampled and JPEG-compressed before conversion to PDF pages.
Added: Before/after size feedback when importing images.

Added: Add Pages menu with Select File, Select Image from Photos and Take Image using Camera.
Updated: Photos and camera captures enter the same PDF page stack as file imports.

Added: Native PDF Multi Tool with a combined multi-document page workspace, thumbnails, page selection and preview.
Added: Cross-document page ordering and custom-named merged PDF export.
Updated: PDF and image imports are processed locally.

Added: Daily Hand In ZIP on/off output choice.
Added: Copy three separately named inspection/JHA PDFs to the iPhone clipboard with a success toast.
Updated: ZIP mode automatically opens the iOS export sheet.
